sn34.46:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo hoti na samādhismim abhinīhārakusalo || || Samādhismim abhinīhārakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo || || Neva samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo hoti na samādhismim abhinīhārakusalo || || Samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo ca || || Seyyathāpi bhikkhave gavā khīraṃ || khīramhā dadhi || dadimhā navanītaṃ || navanītamhā sappi || sappimhā sappimaṇḍo || tatra aggam akkhāyati || evam eva kho bhikkhave yvāyaṃ jhāyī samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo ca samādhismim abhinīhārakusalo ca ayam imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ || pa || uttamo pavaro cāti || || Samādhismiṃ
sn34.47:1.1: gocarakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī || pe || Samādhismim
sn34.48:1.1: gocarakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ sātaccakārī || pe || Samādhismiṃ
sn34.49:1.1: gocarakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ sappāyakārī || pe || || Sāvatthi || ||
